pseudoindex_policy: Drafts use the existing per-asset assignment schema. They are outside catalog/navigation and are not loaded by builds. No invented page numbers, internal ZIM URLs or section maps. Promote individually with matching admitted asset IDs after review; successful verified downloads alone determine build-time availability.
capacity_policy: Aim for 990 GB including library and support data on a nominal decimal 1 TB drive: 5 GB physical-capacity allowance and 5 GB actually free remain separate. Source cohorts are ceilings, not quotas or available-content claims. If a cohort is smaller, select the next reviewed, complete useful cohort toward the ceiling; never claim allowances as files or fill with duplicates. If a source fails, keep it out of the ready catalog and atlas. Recompute actual retained and extracted byte sizes and measured destination free space before profile admission.
admission_order: Review and admit the fully hashed kindergarten and small practical PDFs, including six kindergarten ancillary components before calling the sequence complete
Acquire and hash map/school sources in bounded cohorts; verify extracted Canadian members and notices against the saved directory inventory
Download candidate ZIMs with publisher SHA-256 verification and test representative content using packaged readers completely offline
Admit reviewed records and copy matching per-asset pseudoindexes; build atlas only from successful verified downloads
Review remaining topic/grade/task gaps; file enumeration alone never establishes adequate depth

packing_target.meaning: Library ceiling includes retained downloads, extracted PDFs, all reader packages and their growth allowance, discovery/manifests and edition-growth allowance. Decimal TB versus GiB is unit conversion, not an extra capacity loss.
packing_target.actual_space_gate: Existing build check_space_phases checks shutil.disk_usage(...).free on each filesystem, including caches. If actual capacity/free bytes are insufficient, reduce reviewed selection; no allow-incomplete or estimate can bypass integrity/content policy or disk-space checks.
packing_target.download_layout: Use the default in-place download spool, which renames completed files into their destination. A persistent cache on the same drive duplicates bodies and does not fit this packed plan; use a separate filesystem if a cache is needed. No room is promised for old and new giant ZIM editions simultaneously.
packing_target.reader_accounting: 439,739,570 bytes of pinned reader packages are already included in baseline content. Their total planning budget is 1,000,000,000, leaving 560,260,430 for growth/setup; do not add another reader budget on top.

verification_limits: HEAD/range, magic and archive-directory verification establish observed availability, type and size, not full body integrity. Full SHA-256 verification and source/reader content checks remain admission gates. Only 39 kindergarten and seven practical PDFs were fully downloaded in this pass. No large asset body was indexed.
